structuralHypothesis: A tax-compliance relation requires a tax-domain object, institution or procedure: the procedural word alone (return, due, file, claim, registration, list, output, assessment) carries an ordinary sense that must keep its own domain. An explicit tax predicate governing the target always defeats the ordinary reading, so the governing relation decides rather than the object noun. Concise tax-domain noun phrases are governed requests without a sentence frame.
